# Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (PCA)

> Self-contained study material for one exam. Dense long-form markdown
> reference: comparison matrices, decision trees, exam traps, and
> practice questions with full option-by-option explanations.
>
> Scope note: this index covers this folder only. Other exam folders in
> this repository are independent and have their own llms.txt.

Agents: read CLAUDE.md in this folder (identical to GEMINI.md and
AGENTS.md) before making changes.

## Index

- [Folder index](README.md): reading order and mental map

## Core reference

- [Start here](00-START-HERE/): core reference material, written in full

## Study material (written in full as of the 2026-08-10 bulk-generation pass)

- [Domains](01-domains/): per-domain deep dives (6 files)
- [Services](02-services/): per-service reference (7 files)
- [Comparisons](03-comparisons/): head-to-head decision matrices (6 files)
- [Architectures](04-architectures/): 4 case studies + 2 generic patterns
- [Labs](05-labs/): 5 sequenced hands-on walkthroughs
- [Practice](06-practice/): 6 per-domain question banks + 2 mock exams
- [Revision](07-revision/): 6 cheat sheets + master flashcards
- [Interview](08-interview/): architect-level and behavioral questions
- [Assets](09-assets/): diagrams, mind maps, decision-flowchart index
